policy.parent_scope: only authorized hierarchy references, same bearer/team, shared request deadline; no recursive project sweep
policy.resource_semantics: metadata only, contents not downloaded; unsafe URL credentials omitted; unavailable/incomplete marked
policy.format: readable HTML-to-text; valid Unicode; head/tail truncation marked
policy.followup_reads: one canonical history read, no additional legacy thread-list read
policy.permissions: no caller permission widening or anonymous fallback
policy.freshness: fresh provider document when available; component fallback explicitly unconfirmed; no atomic cross-document claim
policy.response_delivery: Single provider turn by default; answer-only requests need no repository or tool checks; latest directive overrides historical intent gates; fetch additional context only when needed.

limits: does not guarantee model comprehension or semantic completion
attachment and linked document bodies are not fetched by the server

loop.observation: Assignments carried parent titles and one previous message but not bounded parent documents or conversation evidence.
loop.hypothesis: Readable, scoped, bounded context can preserve the task goal while keeping the latest user directive authoritative.
loop.execute: Run synthetic task-context, permission/deadline, conversation-isolation and provider-placement regressions; verify this direct SSOT through knowledgecoverage in CI.
loop.evaluate: Test success, context budgets, resource metadata-only semantics, authorization identity and generated knowledge coverage must pass; live model comprehension is not inferred.
loop.retrospective: Keep inaccessible/truncated inputs explicit and preserve native session/workspace authority; expand context only from authorized references.

execution_status_boundary.persistence: assignment event projection stores bounded context per assignment/thread; cold history and SSE preserve it
execution_status_boundary.privacy: no absolute path/verification argv or credentials in execution_context
execution_status_boundary.legacy: missing context is unknown; never infer passed verification or permit replay
